summary: Branch autoreview (security lens): the security-critical invariant holds — the quickfix cannot be ESCAPED to unlock machinery, because the repo kind is PINNED at window start and read from the pin, so deleting the marker mid-window (by any vector) cannot flip the repo to client-mode; a harness-pinned window also refuses to close while the marker is missing. Common marker-deletion drift (rm/git rm/mv/rm -r .factory) and machinery machinery writes are caught; the marker is plan-only. Trust ceiling is 0013/0029 (drift-defense), stated honestly.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Adversarial marker-deletion / machinery-write vectors beyond the Bash heuristic (cwd games, git -C, exotic cp/mv, python -c os.remove) are out of scope per 0013 — visible in git, backstopped by artifact gates, never a lock disarm given the pin.

residual_risks: The lock is drift-defense, not an adversarial sandbox (0013, user-confirmed ceiling matching 0029): a determined session can still open its own quickfix or use an exotic shell form. All such acts are git-visible and artifact-gate-backstopped; none disarm the lock silently.
